name: Kyle Hyde
source:
[url=/v697]Wish Room: Tenshi no Kioku[/url]

A thirty-three-year-old former N.Y.P.D. detective. He’s been a traveling salesman for the past three years, but continues to search for his missing ex-partner, [url=/c149563]Brian Bradley[/url]. He presents a gruff and cavalier exterior, but drops all pretense when something grabs his attention.

[url=/v4617]Last Window: Mayonaka no Yakusoku[/url]

34-year-old ex-NYPD cop. Four years ago he shot his crooked partner, then quit the force. He is stubborn and rational, but tends to lose track of time when he has something on his mind.

[Taken from game manuals]
